correctness.rationale: For all m,n≥5, an explicit seven-pairs-per-vertex collapse identifies a CW presentation with two disks per torus face sharing its oriented boundary. The primitive square-boundary kernel gives the exact integral basis F and S_f. A coordinate reflection sends S_f to S_hf and F to -F+sum S; translation invariance forces an impossible integer coefficient -1/2 for an equivariant section, while 2F-sum S lifts twice the quotient generator. This proves nonsplitting and exact order two. VERIFY.py separately checks 1337 free-face pairs and 1528 signed disk-action comparisons across six sizes; infinite claim rests on proof.
